adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when validation fails (`handleAdd`), but the mutation `onSuccess` only closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue` (`setIsOpenDialog(false); setMultiEmailValue([""]);`) and does not call `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`. Since the dialog component remains mounted in `BookingListItem` and only its `open` prop changes, reopening the dialog can show the stale error banner before any new input.
